listSources: Exophase / PSNProfiles official list as reported 2026-11-18 (see RULES)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you earn. It pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly — follow the roadmap, finish the story, clear the 100% checklist, and this one closes the list. Because A Long Road (100% completion) is one of the 54, the platinum cannot pop before the checklist is finished.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but work you do earlier still counts. It is a 35-task checklist covering the story, the stranger strands, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations — expect around 200 hours in total, which is why guides rank this the hardest trophy in the game.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist wants 300. Your stunt total is tracked in your stats, so you can check the count any time and mop up the rest after the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds across the two ranges. Treat each range like a checklist and work through every weapon challenge until each one shows gold. The ranges are open from early in the game, so chip away at them between missions instead of leaving all 42 for the end.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. Vault jobs unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone — and expect a 4-star wanted level the moment you leave, which is also how Hot Together pops.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies, so they do not add to this counter. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Watch out for one time-sensitive step: the Chapter 3 race Race Against Yago, in Yago's street racing strand, carries an hourglass icon — do it the moment it appears, and save first.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida and each set needs every card in it, so this is a scavenger hunt best done with a checklist after the story, when the whole map is open and you can sweep region by region.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. The app marks spots around the map — visit them and check in. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts toward discovering them for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together as you travel.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once — nine activity types in total, from racing and fishing to the arcade and the shooting range. Just sample each one; you do not need to win or master any of them, so this pops early if you poke at everything the map offers.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races include street races, Top Fun drone races and more — a win in a race you have already won does not count twice, so keep finding fresh events around the map instead of repeating your favourite.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest route is a bank vault job: it hands you 4 stars at once, and escaping with your partner pops this alongside Maximum Withdrawal. You must fully leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, before it pops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back to back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner first, then hit three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of hunting for specific cars. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail into every region until the map is fully revealed — the trophy tracks map coverage, so check the map for dark corners you have not visited. It pops naturally while you chase collectibles, WAiNK spots and card sets.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Illegal operations are marked around the map; one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so keep laundering instead of spending the bills directly.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations in total. One win per location is enough; you do not need to win every race at each spot. Work through the locations as you travel the map.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative and counts every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food and more — so it fills up naturally as you play, faster once you start buying garages and gear.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — eight garages, bought through the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count. Buy them early: you need the garage space for the Scooter Bros registrations in On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal's fishing challenges appear at fishing spots around Leonida; accept one and out-fish him. Do it in Chapter 1 while the coast is quiet — it is one of the earliest trophies you can bank before the story picks up.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to its end — any game counts, and finishing is all it takes. Arcades are an easy early trophy while you are still learning the map.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots, per KeenGamer's guide. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (usually after the mission Down to Earth), follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task. Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops, because it is not confirmed that the balcony spot is strictly required — do it anyway.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus, giving you time for all five.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Tail a truck, hit it, grab the cash and break away from the police. Like Hot Together, the trophy only pops once you have fully left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50 — check the list after each session and pick off the ones closest to done.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Unmissable — it pops as you play the first mission of the story, and it is the first trophy most players will earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Unmissable — it pops when the first chapter ends. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it lands a moment late. Before Chapter 1 ends, make sure Lucia's balcony meditation is done: it feeds Positive Mental Attitude and disappears with the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Unmissable — story progress only. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: partner switching begins, the Vice City Real Estate app unlocks garages after Daily Driver, and the mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app, so start Little Boxes and On the Spot here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Unmissable — story progress only. Chapter 3 is the busiest chapter for trophies: the Snap Gun mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs opens Sneakthief, partner shop robberies open Retail Therapy, and the time-sensitive Race Against Yago appears in Yago's street racing strand — do that race the moment you see its hourglass icon.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Unmissable — story progress only. Late in this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens bank vaults, so run it before the finale if you want Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together out of the way early.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Unmissable — it pops when the story ends. Before you start it, keep one untouched manual save from just before the mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your only way back if you want to redo anything in the finale. After the credits, everything outside the story stays available, including the side-story finales and the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable — it pops when the mission's final objective completes. Named story-mission trophies like this one can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so a short delay is normal.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — it pops when the heist is done. Heist missions are the big set pieces of the story; there is no way to fail the trophy itself, only the mission, and a retry costs nothing but time.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends. Like the other named-mission trophies, it follows story progress and needs no special setup.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends. If it does not pop on the final cutscene, it usually lands at the start of the next chapter.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends. The mission takes place at Vice City International Airport, the same area where Catch Me If You Can is earned, so you will already know the layout when you come back for the jet.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends. It is one of the later named-mission trophies, so expect it in the back half of the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline stays available after the credits, so this cannot be missed — finish his strand whenever you like, in the story or in post-game cleanup.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand stays open after the story, so there is no deadline — finish it during the post-game sweep. Note that Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only and stays available after the credits, so switch to Lucia for it and finish it in the post-game sweep. Like Billy's strand, it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand stays open after the story, so finish it in the post-game sweep with the other side-story finales.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and stays available after the credits. It does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt grades you on.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off, then fly about 1 km away from the airport for the trophy to pop. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — 'kinda hot in these Rhinos'. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia — a partnership with mass appeal. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there; the partner trains alongside you, so both characters climb together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the game and check the counter in your stats now and then. By the time the story and the robberies are done, it is usually close.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. It will most likely pop while you visit Ocean Beach and order a drink with the ocean in view. Treat this one as unconfirmed until players pin it down; check the sources below for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. The description points at a vehicle showroom: smash your way out of one in classic style. It is most likely tied to a showroom robbery or escape — try it once the story opens showrooms up, and check the sources below once the community confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — 'Second time's the charm' hints at failing something once and succeeding on the second try. It may pop during normal play; no reliable trigger is known yet, so do not grind for it — let it come to you and check the sources below for updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — 'What the hell just happened?' suggests a strange or scripted oddity somewhere in Leonida. Keep playing; it will most likely pop on its own, and the community is still hunting for its trigger. Check the sources below for updates rather than chasing rumours.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. The name and description — 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' — point at the bowling alley and a drive-by with a melee weapon. Unconfirmed; the most likely spot is Kingpin Bowling, the same alley as Let's Go Bowling, so try it there once you have a vehicle and a melee weapon.
